name: Kimi to Issho ni Ikitai no Desu
original_name: 君といっしょにいきたいのです
source:
The story of two people who have nothing left to lose.

"On days when the sky is this beautiful, I feel like I could do anything.
I wish for the other world to be less painful than this one."

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26798]Freem![/url]]
